Will I Get My Card Issuance Fee Back if I Delete My Card?

July 24, 2026

No. When you delete a card, the issuance fee you paid can't be refunded.

For the steps to delete your card, see How Do I Delete a RedotPay Card?
​

Note: Deleting a card is also permanent, so the card can't be restored afterward.
